Serum CA-125 was elevated at 95 U/mL
a predominantly cystic mass measuring 28.3 × 24.4 × 16.3 cm extending from the pelvis to the upper abdomen
response.rationale: The vignette describes a large complex ovarian mass with thick septations and elevated CA-125, strongly indicating ovarian cystadenocarcinoma. R1 uniquely combines all key features without contradictions, while R6 is a broader neoplasm label.

rejected.why: Benign mucinous cystadenoma contradicted by elevated CA-125 and complex septations.
Serous cystadenoma contradicted by elevated CA-125.
Dermoid cyst contradicted by complex septations and elevated CA-125.
Tuberculous ovarian cyst lacks TB evidence and contradicted by CA-125.
Endometriosis contradicted by large complex mass and elevated CA-125.
Tuberculosis contradicted by normal vital signs and no systemic findings.
Ovarian torsion contradicted by elevated CA-125 and lack of acute pain.
Pelvic inflammatory disease contradicted by large complex mass and CA-125.
Diverticulitis contradicted by normal vital signs and adnexal mass.
